title: Check an attached evidence record
responsibility: Validate the original record and its manifest identity and file declarations before projecting it.

inputs.name: hubAttachedRecord.result
inputs.description: The attached evidence result carries its pointer, optional manifest and record, retained file bytes, immutable file facts, and accumulated problems; this check reads record.json and appends its findings to problems. A present manifest is assumed when record.json validates, so a missing manifest can throw a TypeError.

inputs.name: hubRecordJson.bytes
inputs.description: The bytes passed to fatal UTF-8 decoding and JSON.parse; invalid UTF-8 or JSON syntax produces undefined rather than an exception.

outputs.name: hubRecordJson
outputs.description: The parsed JSON value without schema validation, or undefined if UTF-8 decoding or JSON parsing fails.

outputs.name: hubAttachedRecord
outputs.description: Returns a shallow copy, replacing record with the validated parsed value when one is yielded and appending validator errors. If no record is yielded, it appends record.json is not a record; otherwise it also reports seal or manifest identity mismatches and declared files whose path, SHA-256, byte count, or media type does not match, while excluding captures of referenced scenarios.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown when record.json validates but the optional manifest is absent, because the implementation dereferences the manifest for identity and file checks.
